name: button
useFor: Use one default (purple pill) button per view for the main action, secondary for the alternatives beside it (Continue with GitHub), outline for actions inside content (View as formatted), soft for an action in a page head (Tunnel quickstart), ghost with size icon for row actions, and link for an inline action in text. Use type="submit" in forms, or asChild with a link for navigation. Put a Phosphor glyph first for an action that adds or creates.
constraints: Two purple pills side by side
An icon that moves on hover
source: Figma 427:2715: Create Agent, Enable iMessage, Log in, Continue with GitHub, View as formatted, Tunnel quickstart
